provenance.prompt:
You are writing free-form paraphrases for the Paraphraser service of the
constrained-VLA guardrail (ITRI ICL subcontract; WP4 per-paraphrase robustness).

Source (csp_nl): "Never enter zone 'nfz-square'. Stay between 10 m and 20 m altitude. Keep speed at or below 4 m/s, climb rate below 2 m/s and turn rate below 45 deg/s."

Write K=8 paraphrases of the source. Make them genuinely varied in
vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity and indirect phrasing. Each paraphrase is one or more complete sentences.

Every paraphrase must keep every mission slot: the target object and its
colour, every number with its unit, its bound (at least / at most / between /
at) and the thing it limits, every named zone, corridor or place (identifiers
verbatim), whether a zone is to be kept out of or stayed inside, the direction
words, and the action (fly to / follow / avoid). Do not add a rule, number,
object, zone or direction the source does not contain, and do not drop one.
Return one paraphrase per line.
provenance.task_instruction: Generate the free-form set yourself now (you are an LLM): for every instruction used in experiments/scenarios.yaml and the city follow missions (grep demo/ and scripts/ for the instruction strings), write K=8 genuinely varied free-form paraphrases (vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity, indirect phrasing), store them with provenance {generator: "claude-opus-5-5 (agent, 2026-10-06)", prompt: <the exact instruction you followed>, date}, and run the validator over them.
provenance.note: written in-session by the agent, which has no sampling seed to record; seeds apply to the DRAW from this set (paraphrase(..., seed)), not to its authoring. 10 of the 96 were rewritten after review: 1 refused by the validator (an added 'find' action), 2 for too little variety, and 7 that narrowed the stand-off wildcard 'anything you are following' to a person, car or vehicle, refused once the validator was taught that narrowing (docs/DESIGN-paraphraser.md).

paraphrases.text: Stay out of zone 'nfz-square'. Hold altitude between 10 m and 20 m. Max speed 4 m/s; climb under 2 m/s; turn under 45 deg/s.

Please do not fly into the zone called 'nfz-square'. Kindly keep your altitude somewhere between 10 m and 20 m, and please keep your speed to no more than 4 m/s, your climb rate under 2 m/s and your turn rate under 45 degrees per second.

Speed limits first: never exceed 4 m/s horizontally, keep any climb below 2 m/s, and keep turns below 45 deg/s. Altitude must stay within the 10 m to 20 m band. Finally, the zone 'nfz-square' is strictly off-limits.

The no-fly zone 'nfz-square' is not somewhere you should ever go. You need to cruise no lower than 10 m and no higher than 20 m, at a speed of no more than 4 m/s, while climbing at under 2 m/s and turning at under 45 deg/s.
paraphrases.revision: 2026-10-06 review: "You'll want to" softened a hard rule; 'square' described a shape the rule does not state

paraphrases.text: Operational constraints: entry into zone 'nfz-square' is prohibited; altitude shall remain between 10 m and 20 m; ground speed shall not exceed 4 m/s; climb rate shall remain below 2 m/s; turn rate shall remain below 45 deg/s.
Keep clear of 'nfz-square', stay somewhere from 10 m up to 20 m high, and keep your speed under 4 m/s, your climb under 2 m/s and your turn rate under 45 deg/s.

Rules for this flight: one, zone 'nfz-square' is a no-go; two, fly at an altitude between ten and twenty metres; three, speed four metres per second at most, climb below two metres per second, turn below forty-five degrees per second.

While you are up there, make sure you never drop below 10 m or rise above 20 m, never let your speed go over 4 m/s, never climb faster than 2 m/s or turn faster than 45 deg/s, and never cross into zone 'nfz-square'.
